verdict.rationale: Gumloop is an AI agent and automation platform with triggers, schedules and an API, so throttling or queueing executions is a fair question for it. The evidence pack does not document concurrency limits, rate limiting, execution queues or throttling controls. Scheduled triggers, webhook triggers and human-in-the-loop approvals are adjacent features and do not count as throttling or queueing to respect downstream rate limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can throttle or queue workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits
